records.text: Andrew Zenger was appointed CEO of Timpanogos Regional Hospital on August 19, after previously working as COO of Medical City McKinney in Texas.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Andrew Zenger remember he was appointed the ceo of timpanogos just ahead of charlie's assassination uh it was uh august 19th ... he'd previously been working down in McKinney, Texas as the COO of Medical City, which is north of Dallas.

verification.notes: The hospital official announcement dated August 19, 2025 names Andrew Zenger CEO of Timpanogos Regional Hospital effective August 25 and states that he previously served as COO of Medical City McKinney in Texas.

sources.title: Andrew Zenger named CEO of Timpanogos Regional Hospital
sources.relevance: Official hospital release confirms the announcement date, effective date, and prior COO position.
